2

4		pytest -m "not postgres" -q
5	
6	test:
7		pytest -q
8

Use the Makefile targets:

- `make test-fast` runs `pytest -m "not postgres" -q`. This is the project's recorded convention. It skips tests marked `postgres`, so it needs no database.
- `make test` runs the full suite with `pytest -q`. The `postgres`-marked tests will probably need a Postgres instance available. I didn't check how the tests connect to one.

I didn't run either target, so I haven't confirmed they pass.
